name: 31BR
source:
An entry into the 2008 TIGSource Commonplace Book Competition, where the participants had to make a game inspired by an entry from H.P. Lovecraft's notebook.

"31BR is a short visual novel where you're a man who's trying to sell a museum one of his pieces. It has 4 possible endings."

[Source: [url=https://forums.tigsource.com/index.php?topic=3757.0]TIGSource forums[/url]]
translation:
参加2008年TIGSource Commonplace图书竞赛的参赛作品，参赛者必须根据H.P. 的参赛作品制作一款游戏。洛夫克拉夫特的笔记本。

“《31BR》是一部短篇视觉小说，其中你是一个试图向博物馆出售他的一件作品的男人。它有4个可能的结局。”

[来源：[url=https://forums.tigsource.com/index.php?topic=3757.0]TIGSource论坛[/url]]
